_comment: Configuration file for Takaro Inventory Tracker
_port_description: The port number the server will listen on. Default: 5555
_takaroApi_description: The Takaro API endpoint. Should not need to change unless Takaro updates their API URL.
_locationToleranceSeconds_description: How close in time an inventory change must be to a position ping inside the search circle to count as happening there. Takaro samples position every ~30-100s, so some slack is required. Lower = stricter (fewer false hits, may miss real ones). Higher = looser. Default: 300 (5 minutes).
_theftRadius_description: Theft Detection has no radius field in the UI. This is how close to the entered coordinates a pickup must happen to be reported. Default: 50 blocks.
_historyLookbackDays_description: Takaro only stores a row while an item is IN a player's inventory - a loss is recorded as an absence, never a quantity of 0. So an item appearing for the first time is a real pickup (0 -> N). This is how far back before your search window to read in order to tell 'brand new' from 'had it all along'. Default: 7 days.
